name: Customize
description: Every plugin's page takes the person's own style and script (ADR 0398): asked of Eris or run from the palette as desk.customize.*, kept for the endue account signed in (this computer's set while nobody is) and applied again at every start and sign-in.

desk.customize.enabled.description: Whether plugin pages get the person's styles and scripts. Turn it off to see every page as its plugin draws it; nothing kept is lost. Safe mode never applies them.
